collections.label: About page
collections.description: The words and photos on the About page, including the Currently list you refresh each quarter.

fields.label: Closing banner title (max 60; empty uses the site default)
Closing banner text (max 200; empty uses the site default)
Headshot (a square or 4:5 photo, at least 864 px wide)
Headshot description for screen readers (max 120). The photo is left out without it
One-line thesis, the part before the blue phrase (max 140)
One-line thesis, the part after the blue phrase (max 140)
The story (paragraphs only: bold, italic and links work; headings, lists and pictures are ignored)
Photos (3 to 6, shown in this order). Caption under 40 characters, description under 160. A photo without a description is left out
The three principles (exactly 3). Title under 48 characters, text under 360
Currently last updated (set this to today whenever you change the lists below)
Working on (1 to 3 lines, each under 140 characters)
Booking (1 to 3 rows). Label under 24 characters, details under 220. Status: Open shows green, Limited shows amber, and the word is always printed too
Reading (1 to 4 books). Title under 60 characters, author under 40, note under 24 (optional, for example "re-reading")
Learning (1 to 4 lines, each under 100 characters)
Client quotes heading (max 40). The quotes come from the case studies
Lighthouse Performance (0 to 100). Measured fact: only change after a real re-measure
Lighthouse Accessibility (0 to 100). Measured fact: only change after a real re-measure
Lighthouse Best Practices (0 to 100). Measured fact: only change after a real re-measure
Lighthouse SEO (0 to 100). Measured fact: only change after a real re-measure
Job title for search engines (max 80). Not shown on the page

collections.label: Home page
collections.description: The words on the homepage: headline, section headings, the process steps.

fields.label: Headline, the plain first part (max 32). It reads as one sentence with the coloured part next
Headline, the coloured last part (max 28). Shows in amber on dark and blue on light
Proof line, words before the link (max 100)
Proof line, the linked words (max 24). They link to the About page
Proof line, words after the link (max 40)
Main button label (max 24). It always goes to the Contact page
Second link label (max 24). It always goes to the Work page
Selected work text under the heading (max 200)
Selected work link label under the cards (max 40). It goes to the Work page
Lead-in to the list of what every build includes (max 80)
What every build includes (exactly 4 lines, keep each under 48 characters)
Reassurance line under the tiers (max 260). Check it if your payment terms change
Pricing link label (max 48). It goes to the Services page
Process heading (max 40). Also shown on the Services page
Process text under the heading (max 160). Also shown on the Services page
The process steps (exactly 4; numbers 01 to 04 are added for you). Title under 32 characters, body under 300. Also shown on the Services page
Closing block button label (max 24). It always goes to the Contact page

collections.label: Services page
collections.description: The words on the Services page: headline, cost and FAQ sections.

fields.label: Closing banner title (max 60; empty uses the site default)
Closing banner text (max 200; empty uses the site default)
Cost section paragraph, above the tier cards (max 400). The prices themselves are under Pricing tiers
Heading over the add-on cards (max 32). The cards are under Add-ons
The reasons (exactly 4, in two columns). Title under 40 characters, text under 360
Closing paragraph under the reasons, about the tools you use (max 420)
Questions and answers (3 to 10; question under 140 characters, answer under 900). Google shows these in search, so keep them true. If an answer quotes a price, check it against Pricing tiers

collections.label: Add-ons
collections.description: The "Add to any project" cards on the Services page.

fields.label: Price as it should read, for example "from $900" or "$500 to $2,000" (max 24)
Order on the page, 1 is first (only the first 3 show)

collections.label: Pricing tiers
collections.description: The three website tiers on the homepage and the Services page.

fields.label: Starting price in whole dollars, for example 4000 (counts up on the page)
Mark after the price, for example + (max 2)
Who it is for, a few words (max 40)
Typical range line (check it against the Services FAQ "What does it cost?"; max 60)
Paragraph describing the tier, shown on Services (max 320)
What is included (2 to 5 lines, keep each under 80 characters)
Recommended tier (tick on one tier only: it gets the accent treatment and the badge)
Badge on the recommended tier, for example "Where most projects land" (max 32)
Order on the page, 1 is first (only the first 3 tiers show)

collections.label: Service offerings
collections.description: The Strategy, Web design and Photography chapters on the Services page.

fields.label: Paragraph under the summary (max 500). Also the description Google reads
Standalone starting price in whole dollars, for example 1500 (read by Google, not shown on the page). Leave empty for Web design: it follows the first Pricing tier
Describe the picture (max 160). Only Web design has a picture; empty shows the placeholder panel instead
Icon on the placeholder panel (used when there is no picture)
What is included (3 to 5 lines, keep each under 90 characters)
Where you offer it, for Google: "regional" is the greater Cincinnati region only, "anywhere" adds the whole United States
Order on the page, 1 is first (only the first 3 show)

Tagline (footer, search results and the feed; max 160)

Newsletter sign-up link (empty hides the newsletter block)

Footer "Currently" line (change with the season; max 180)
